+package org.openjdk.jmc.flightrecorder.selection;
+
+import java.util.List;
+import java.util.stream.Stream;
+
+import org.openjdk.jmc.common.item.IAttribute;
+import org.openjdk.jmc.common.item.IItemCollection;
+import org.openjdk.jmc.common.item.IItemFilter;
+
+/**
+ * A named selection that can be presented in different flavors.
+ */
+public interface IFlavoredSelection {
+
+	/**
+	 * Whether this represents an absent selection, rather than an empty event population.
+	 *
+	 * @return true for an absent selection
+	 */
+	boolean isEmpty();
+
+	String getName();
+
+	/**
+	 * Get a stream of flavors
+	 *
+	 * @param filter
+	 *            Destination filter used to rank aspects and discover applicable properties. It
+	 *            does not restrict the direct-events aspect or the universe of property aspects.
+	 * @param items
+	 *            Full recording universe used to discover and evaluate related aspects
+	 * @param attributes
+	 *            Attributes that can be used to select suitable flavors
+	 * @return A stream of flavors
+	 */
+	Stream<IItemStreamFlavor> getFlavors(IItemFilter filter, IItemCollection items, List<IAttribute<?>> attributes);
+
+}

+package org.openjdk.jmc.flightrecorder.selection;
+
+/**
+ * A flavor of a selection that can be evaluated to a chosen type. The input data is contained
+ * within the flavor instance. Retaining a flavor can therefore retain its recording data. Flavors
+ * should be scoped to their recording owner or the operation that evaluates them.
+ *
+ * @param <T>
+ *            Type that the flavor can be evaluated to.
+ */
+public interface ISelectionFlavor<T> {
+
+	/**
+	 * An identifier independent of the display name and destination ordering.
+	 *
+	 * @return an identifier unique among the aspects of a selection in a destination context
+	 */
+	String getIdentifier();
+
+	String getName();
+
+	default Boolean isEmpty() {
+		return false;
+	}
+
+	/**
+	 * @return Evaluated flavor value
+	 */
+	T evaluate();
+}
